value.rationale: The complete inverse image size of a noiseless cyclic read profile is the exact ambiguity of sequence assembly, and profile counts equal zero-error code capacity. Sharp finite-onset length nine ambiguity, exact singleton feasibility conditions, all-length rational enumerators, least periods 12/6, and asymptotic vanishing of uniquely reconstructible fraction solve natural structural and information-theoretic questions not supplied by unrestricted word counts. The constrained setting is motivated by run-length-limited DNA reads, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
